nina-cs: New intake from Suncrest Medical. They need a discharge summarizer; PHI must remain in their VPC. Asking for tokenizer that keeps patient IDs and names intact, and a safety/regression run. Timeline: pilot in 3 weeks.

Suncrest Medical (customer):
> Requirements:
> - PHI must not leave our VPC; PHI requests route to Private deployment.
> - Tokenizer must not split patient IDs or multi-part names.
> - Offline regression harness (30k tokens) comparing to legacy summaries.
> - Canary deploy with rollback if p95 latency > 550ms or regression > 3%.

ben-cs: i'll take kickoff and ask for sample data + network contacts.

omar-se: on routing: we can tag phi at edge with a small regex/ML filter and forward to Private control plane. need their VPN/CIDR + webhook allowlist.

lee-ml: tokenizer options: (1) rebuild tokenizer with special tokens for IDs/names (preferred), (2) preprocess replace IDs with placeholder token (faster). prefer (1) if they can share mapping.

tara-sec: security checklist: confirm PHI regexes, KMS access for Private, disable KV cache persistence for PHI, audit log forwarding to their SIEM.

nina-cs: propose plan: 1) kickoff+artifacts (day 0-2) 2) tokenizer prototype + 5k smoke eval (day 3-6) 3) full 30k harness + security checks (day 7-12) 4) canary + rollback config (day 13-18) 5) pilot handoff (day 19-21).

ben-cs: action items: request golden set + VPN details by EOD tomorrow.

onboard-bot: Created onboarding card REDW-5279 -> Suncrest PHI tokenizer & routing. Owner: ben-cs. Due: 1995200000.

omar-se: small example routing rule for SREs: 
```yaml
routing_rules:
  - name: phi_detect_basic
    match: "regex:\b(SSN|MRN|patient_name)\b"
    action: route_private
fallback_policy:
  latency_threshold_ms: 550
  fallback_model: small-13b-quant
```

lee-ml: note: will add validation job after tokenizer change to check embedding/logit drift vs baseline.

nina-cs: setting expectation: ~3 weeks if artifacts arrive in 48h. will send recap to customer and schedule kickoff.

tara-sec: will draft PHI questionnaire for legal/compliance.

nina-cs: closing this thread until kickoff. :white_check_mark:
